rationale: The short thesis is executing on schedule — price has stair-stepped lower with unbroken lower highs since entry, the last 1m bar closed at the session low on rising volume, and price remains far below both VWAP ($54.98) and the 9-EMA ($53.97) in a persistent risk-off tape, leaving roughly half an ATR to the $53.10 target.
